info.title: Postroom API
info.description: REST/JSON under /api for the Postroom webmail. Generated from the zod schemas that validate requests (PST-REQ-085); regenerate with `pnpm --filter @postroom/api openapi`.

id.description: The draft’s message id. A save replaces the draft, so this changes every save.

highestModseq.description: A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.
A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.

html.description: The HTML part exactly as sent. NOT sanitised: render it only on the usercontent origin (PST-T-3.12).

modseq.description: A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.

trashedAt.description: When the message entered Trash (the retention clock); null outside Trash.

expiresAt.description: When the retention sweep expunges it from Trash; null outside Trash or when Trash keeps mail forever.

modseq.description: A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.

trashedAt.description: When the message entered Trash (the retention clock); null outside Trash.

url.description: The sanitised message on the usercontent origin: frame it with sandbox (no allow-scripts, no allow-same-origin). A capability; expires at expiresAt.

images.description: Whether remote images load (through the proxy) in this render.

remoteImages.description: Remote images in the message. Above 0 with images false means some are blocked.

trackersBlocked.description: Known tracking pixels dropped entirely from this message, never loaded even with images on (PST-REQ-116).

linksCleaned.description: Links with a tracking parameter stripped or a known redirect wrapper unwrapped (PST-REQ-116).

messageId.description: The Message-ID header of the sent message.

threadId.description: The thread the Sent copy joined (null only if threading failed; the sweep retries).

post.summary: Send a message through the submission path, and file it in Sent.
post.description: Builds a strict-CRLF RFC 5322 message (text/plain UTF-8, encoded-words for non-ASCII headers; a forward attaches the original as message/rfc822) and runs it through the same submission path as SMTP on 587/465: From must be one of the caller’s addresses, it is DKIM-signed, the recipient cap is enforced, and it is queued and audited — then filed in Sent in the same transaction and threaded. A draftId is removed from Drafts in that transaction.

403.description: Missing CSRF header, or From is not one of the caller’s addresses.

404.description: forwardOf is not a message of the caller.

413.description: The header block is too large.

503.description: No DKIM keys for the sender domain (never sent unsigned), or POSTROOM_KEK is not set.

get.description: Starts with one mailbox.changed per mailbox, then message.new (MessageNewEvent) and mailbox.changed (MailboxChangedEvent) as mail arrives or changes. A comment heartbeat every 25 s. Only the caller's mailboxes.

post.summary: Start a full-data export of the caller's account: mbox per folder + manifest.json in a ZIP (PST-REQ-151).
post.description: Needs a fresh step-up and x-postroom-csrf: 1. One active export per account: a second call while one is pending or running is 409. The archive is deleted 24 h after it finishes.

403.description: Missing CSRF header, or step-up required.

409.description: An export is already pending or running for this account.

get.summary: The status of one export of the caller's.

404.description: Not an export of the caller.

get.summary: The finished archive, streamed as application/zip.
get.description: Needs a fresh step-up. 409 while the export is still pending/running; 404 once done but past its 24 h expiry (the archive was swept).

404.description: Not an export of the caller, or the archive has expired.

409.description: The export is not finished yet.

patch.summary: Add/remove flags and/or move to another mailbox.
patch.description: Requires If-Match with the ETag from GET. A move creates the message in the target with a new UID (and a new id), removes it from the source, and bumps both mailboxes' HIGHESTMODSEQ. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, or *.

items.description: A system flag (\Seen, \Answered, \Flagged, \Draft) or an IMAP keyword atom.
A system flag (\Seen, \Answered, \Flagged, \Draft) or an IMAP keyword atom.

get.summary: A short-lived URL of the sanitised HTML on the usercontent origin (PST-REQ-081).
get.description: The usercontent origin has no session cookie, so this mints a capability for one message of the caller, under the caller's session, valid for 15 minutes. Remote images stay blocked unless images=1, and then load only through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082). Frame the URL with sandbox and no allow-scripts/allow-same-origin.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: 1 = the reader chose to load remote images, through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082).

schema.description: 1 = the reader chose to load remote images, through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082).

404.description: Not a message of the caller.

post.summary: A configuration profile for Mail, Calendar and Contacts on this account (PST-REQ-139).
post.description: Mints one fresh app password scoped for imap+smtp+dav and embeds it in an Apple configuration profile (Content-Type application/x-apple-aspen-config). Signed as CMS SignedData when a signing certificate is configured (X-Postroom-Mobileconfig-Signed: 1); otherwise served unsigned (: 0) and iOS shows it as Unverified. Step-up and audited.

403.description: Missing CSRF header, or step-up required.

404.description: The account has no primary address.

503.description: Auth is not configured (no password pepper).

get.summary: Full-text search over the caller’s mail (PST-REQ-080).

delete.summary: Remove the bucket pin for this sender (a screen decision, if any, is unaffected).

get.summary: The caller's pin for this sender address, if any (PST-REQ-105).

200.description: The pin (bucket is null when there is none).

put.summary: Pin this sender to a bucket — overrides the classifier for their mail (PST-REQ-105).
put.description: A pin into Priority or People still requires the message to authenticate, exactly like the VIP rule. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

post.summary: Answer this sender's new-sender badge: Allow or Block (PST-REQ-106).
post.description: Allow treats the sender as a known contact, so a directly-addressed message from them can reach Priority. Block routes their future mail to Junk. Either clears the $NewSender badge on their already-filed mail. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

200.description: The screen decision after the change.

post.summary: Compile a script without storing it (ManageSieve CHECKSCRIPT).
post.description: valid is false and error names the 1-based line and column of the first compile error.

post.summary: Deactivate every script: new mail is sorted by the classifier alone.

get.summary: The caller's Sieve scripts (at most one active), the supported extensions and the limits.

delete.summary: Delete a script. The active script is refused.

409.description: The script is active; deactivate it first.

put.summary: Create or replace a script; it is stored only if it compiles.
put.description: The same store ManageSieve PUTSCRIPT writes (RFC 5804): the script must compile with every extension Postroom supports; a compile error is refused with its line and column. An active script stays active. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

409.description: The account already has the most scripts it may.

422.description: The script does not compile: compileError has the line and column.

post.summary: Make this the one active script; the worker runs it on new mail.

get.summary: A thread and the caller's messages in it, oldest first.

404.description: Not a thread of the caller.
